chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample F, 3/5
chunks.content: Sample F scored 3/5 (Ineffectual Argument for a New Understanding). Topic: electric vehicles (a 'to what extent' research question about their impact/adoption). A focused question and method are present, but the argument for a new understanding is ineffectual — the analysis does not adequately support or convey the claimed new understanding. Illustrates the 3 band.
